{{Quote|Nuso Esva could do an enormous amount of damage to the people of the Red City in those two years.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
The '''Red City''' was [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]] that was located to the south of the [[Dreaming Waters]] and was the seat of power of the [[Quesoth]] [[Queen of the Red]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] traveled to the Red City and made a deal with the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] whereby he would aide the Queen at overthrowing the [[Queen of the White]], who was due to succeed the Queen of the Red as ruler of Quethold. Esva lured the [[Empire of the Hand]] into [[Attack on the Red City|attacking]] the Red City and planned to defeat the Imperials and steal some Imperial [[juggernaut]]s. However, the Imperials successfully captured the Red City and defeated Esva and the Quesoth.
